label: CU loop • no surface for the confirm card ends the run with the reason
notes: Deterministic (scripted-model) case for the headless-confirm contract: under `balanced` the Save commit needs approval, but the harness reports that no chat window can render the card (a delegated child with the chat closed, a background dispatch). The loop must not park on the card until the wall clock; it fails fast as gaveUp naming the reason, and the gated action must not run.
